proposedOwnedSourceContract.predicate: When the exact repository has observation-document policy, fail the commit if any staged docs inventory path lacks its actual staged policy classification.
proposedOwnedSourceContract.source: Use actual Git index enumeration and staged policy blob, not unstaged worktree inventory. Preserve full existing classification schema, uniqueness, audience/lifecycle/path checks; unavailable/malformed observations refuse.
proposedOwnedSourceContract.applicability: Self-repository observation policy only. Installed consumer with no such policy retains existing behavior; missing policy where required does not silently exempt.
proposedOwnedSourceContract.integration: Expose existing pure inventory validator from a shipped shared library, keep harness checker the consumer, add fixed staged precommit consumer to verified runtime snapshot resource closure; do not name source-only harness paths inside generic installed plugin.
proposedOwnedSourceContract.conservation: No Git config/hooks/signing/authority overrides. No automatic classification, private field export, generic runtime callback or new approval.
